skill.name: cargo-mcp
skill.description: Guide Cargo hosted MCP connections, workspace verification, action pricing, record and batch execution, polling, and model reads through an authenticated AI client.
skill.summary: Connect to Cargo MCP, inspect action costs, execute approved records or batches, and retrieve workspace data.
skill.author: getcargohq

security_audit.summary: All 69 static findings are false positives involving Markdown formatting, documentation links, or intended Cargo connectivity and workspace checks. One semantic concern remains: paid pilot execution precedes the explicit approval step. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious command execution in the supplied files; hosted service implementation was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: Pilot records can incur charges before the documented user approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval of the pilot record count, data destinations, and credit budget before execution, then obtain separate approval for the full batch.

semantic_findings.title: Paid Pilot Before Explicit Approval
semantic_findings.description: The instruction says "Run 10–20 records first" and requests user approval only after reporting the sample and quoting the full batch. An agent following this sequence can spend credits and process personal records before explicit pilot authorization.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented sequence explicitly places the pilot before approval of the full run. Prior user authorization could mitigate this, but the skill does not require it.

content.user_title: Connect Cargo MCP and Run Workspace Actions
content.value_statement: Using Cargo through an AI client requires correct authentication, workspace selection, and action inputs. This skill guides hosted MCP connections, cost inspection, batch execution, and result reporting.
actual_capabilities: Guide hosted Cargo MCP connection through OAuth or a workspace-scoped bearer token.
Check workspace identity and credits before selecting actions.
Discover actions, inspect credit costs, and retrieve input schemas.
Guide single-record or batch execution and poll runs for completion.
List and describe workspace models, retrieve paginated records, and inspect recent credit usage.
Summarize batch record counts, hit rates, actual credit spend, and output downloads.
limitations: Requires network access, a compatible MCP client, and an authenticated Cargo workspace.
Available tools depend on the connected workspace; documented tools may differ from the discovered list.
Model queries do not support SQL joins, aggregates, or expression filters; pagination can truncate results.
Reusable workflow editing, infrastructure deployment, and mailbox administration require separate CLI skills.

use_cases.title: Connect an AI Client
use_cases.description: Configure hosted Cargo access and verify the correct workspace without installing the Cargo CLI for MCP operations.

use_cases.title: Enrich an Approved Batch
use_cases.description: Inspect action pricing, obtain pilot approval, test a small sample, and submit an approved batch with a downloadable result.

use_cases.title: Configure Headless Access
use_cases.description: Connect a headless client with an environment-supplied workspace token and inspect available tools, schemas, and recent usage.

prompt_templates.title: Connect Cargo
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through connecting Cargo MCP to Claude Desktop with OAuth. Verify and report the workspace before running any action.

prompt_templates.title: Find and Price an Action
prompt_templates.prompt: Find available company enrichment actions in my workspace. Show their credit costs and required inputs. Do not execute any action.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Controlled Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan enrichment for my approved records. Request pilot budget approval before execution. Report sample results, then request separate approval for the remaining batch.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Headless Automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan headless Cargo MCP access using an environment token. Verify workspace identity, discover tools, inspect schemas, and define polling without exposing credentials.

output_examples.input: Explain how Cargo MCP authenticates and checks my workspace.
output: OAuth-capable clients discover authentication from the initial 401 challenge.
Headless clients can use a workspace-scoped token supplied through the environment.
Check workspace identity and report its name before performing actions.

output_examples.input: Explain whether query_models can join models and calculate totals.
output: query_models retrieves records from one model using a limit and offset.
It does not support joins, aggregates, or expression filters.
Use the separate Cargo storage CLI workflow for those queries.

output_examples.input: What should the summary contain after my approved batch finishes?
output: Record count: the number processed by the completed batch.
Hit rate: the share producing usable results.
Credits spent: the actual reported charge.
Download: the output CSV link returned by the batch.

best_practices: Verify and report the authenticated workspace before reading data or running actions.
Approve pilot costs and data processing before execution, then approve the full batch estimate separately.
Inspect action schemas, preserve returned action descriptors, and supply inputs through data or records.
anti_patterns: Running paid pilot records without explicit user authorization.
Placing action inputs in config or looping single-record calls instead of using batch execution.
Treating a limited model query as complete SQL analysis or counting truncated results.

faq.question: Does hosted Cargo MCP require the Cargo CLI?
faq.answer: Hosted MCP operations do not require the Cargo CLI. Separate platform administration tasks use CLI skills; some installer metadata also declares the CLI.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill declares Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support. Actual execution requires a client configured for the hosted Cargo MCP server.

faq.question: Why does the first connection return 401?
faq.answer: The initial unauthenticated response provides OAuth discovery information. Continued failures after authentication require checking client configuration and credentials.

faq.question: How should I handle an API token?
faq.answer: Use a workspace-scoped token from Cargo Settings and supply it through the environment. Do not paste its value into configuration or reports.

faq.question: Can actions spend credits or process personal data?
faq.answer: Yes. Approve pilot and batch budgets before execution, and confirm a lawful basis, suppression checks, and relevance before processing personal records.

faq.question: Why do tools differ between workspaces?
faq.answer: The endpoint includes platform tools and workspace-published tools. Inspect the connected tool list and verify the workspace before choosing an action.
